statements.t: We have incurred substantial losses since inception and expect to incur significant losses in the near term.
There can be no assurance that additional capital will be available or that, if available, it will be available on terms acceptable to us on a timely basis.
We cannot be certain that we will succeed in commercializing our technology or products.

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services are transferred to our customers, in an amount that reflects the consideration that we expect to receive in exchange for those goods or services.

We assign our research and development resources based on the business opportunity of the available projects, the skill mix of the resources available and the contractual commitments we have made to our customers.
We believe that a substantial level of continuing research and development expense will be required to further develop our scanning technology.

Bolstering our strategic plan driven by revenue generation and achievement of operational efficiencies, with such efficiencies stemming from both the March 2026 consolidation plan and further restructuring activities commencing October 2026, we intend to increase liquidity through near-term financing activities, including utilization of the ATM facility.

If we are unable to raise additional capital within the expected timeframe, we may be required to take additional measures to conserve liquidity, which could include, but not necessarily be limited to, streamlining operations and otherwise reducing operating expenses.
